header.shortDesc: Remove 40% more plaque with patented expanding floss technology, strengthen enamel, and support a healthy oral microbiome with SuperMouth’s non-fluoride dental floss. Dentist-formulated with hydroxyapatite (nano-hydroxyapatite), vitamins D3 & K2, prebiotics, and clean ingredients, it’s free from forever chemicals (PFAS) and petroleum-based waxes. Delicious flavors—chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, mint—for adults and kids.
header.superHtml:
You wouldn’t brush your teeth without toothpaste, so why floss without it? Our Hydroxamin®* Floss is infused with the same key ingredients as our premium toothpaste, including nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3, and K2, to provide comprehensive oral care. This innovative floss uses patented expanding technology to remove over 40% more plaque than standard flosses** while being gentle on gums and comfortable around fingers. The super soft floss, combined with our patent-pending formulation of Hydroxamin®, effectively cleans hard-to-reach areas, supporting overall oral health and helping to reduce the risk of tooth decay. Available in mouth-watering flavors like mint, vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry, this dentist-formulated and approved floss ensures a superior flossing experience without any of the harsh chemicals found in conventional products.

  • Infused with Hydroxamin: Contains nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2, along with xylitol to support overall oral health.
  • Patented Expanding Technology: Removes over 40% more plaque than standard flosses** for a deeper clean.
  • No Harsh Chemicals: Free from PFAS/PTFE (Teflon®)/PFOA/BPA, petroleum-based products such as microcrytalline wax, artificial flavors, or colors.
  • Reduces Tooth Decay: Removes plaque and food particles from between teeth to help reduce the risk of tooth decay.
  • Delicious Flavors: Available in mint, vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry.
  • Dentist-Formulated & Approved: Developed and approved by leading dentists for an effective and safe flossing experience.

*contains nano-hydroxyapatite material, vitamins K2 and D3

** Genoa University clinical randomized controlled trial.

*** All SuperMouth products rank a 1 on the EWG scale.
